The '''Cron Cluster''' was a group of ten [[Star/Legends|stars]] once located in the [[Auril sector/Legends|Auril sector]] before the [[Sith sorcerer|Sith sorceress]] [[Aleema Keto]] [[Supernova (Sith magic)|caused]] the stars to [[Cron Supernova/Legends|go supernova]], creating the [[Cron Drift/Legends|Cron Drift]], in [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="TSW4" /> The [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] was presumed to have been constructed by the members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Celestial/Legends|Celestial]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who had disappeared from the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by [[30,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
